name: r013.clean_wait_duration_validation_mcw
description: Independent focused R-013 validation from the clean source-bound wait footing.  It performs the deterministic one-minute native wait transaction and requires a fresh world postcondition without dispatching or recovering an unrelated activity modal.

proof_gates.label: R-013 bound wait-duration transaction reaches a fresh world frame without unrelated recovery

steps.label: post_load_r013_clean_validation_hud
steps.expected_visible_fact: ordinary gameplay HUD shows Move and Wield before the semantic transaction
steps.abort_reason: the independent clean fixture did not reach ordinary gameplay

steps.label: prove_r013_clean_bound_wait
steps.objective: Accept only the current advertised one-minute native wait actions.  Prove the bound wait-duration modal receipt chain, one authoritative minute of progress, and a fresh ordinary world frame.  Do not dispatch activity recovery.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the worker accepts world.wait, observes its current wait-duration modal, accepts advertised wait.1m bound to that modal, advances game time, and reaches a fresh ordinary world frame without an activity-recovery transaction

evidence_contract.claim: one separately authorized clean-scene validation proves the deterministic bound wait-duration receipt chain, changed authoritative time, and fresh world postcondition without an unrelated second modal
evidence_contract.failure_rule: an unadvertised action, rejected or unbound receipt, missing time progress, non-world successor, activity modal, failed ingestion, or failed cleanup leaves R-013 unproved
